attchmntText: TVS Srichakra Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the Un-audited Financial Results (Standalone and Consolidated) and Limited Review Reports for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026.
voiceSummary: TVS Srichakra Limited approved its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, on November 14, 2026. The Board recorded limited review reports from statutory auditors PKF Sridhar & Santhanam LLP. For the half year ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs 2,173.27 crores, with a net profit after tax of Rs 63.77 crores. Earnings per share stood at Rs 8.33. For the quarter ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs 1,175.91 crores, and net profit after tax was Rs 7.07 crores. Earnings per share for the quarter were Rs 0.92. The company reported a receivable of Rs 7.21 crores towards refund of tariffs under the United States International Emergency Economic Powers Act. Exceptional items included Rs 1.69 crores for a voluntary retirement scheme and Rs 18.81 crores from government grants recognized in the previous year.

attchmntText: We are enclosing herewith a copy of the Press Release titled 'Eurogrip s Diwali film visits Chilla, tracing why the festival comes a day late. Exploring the intrigue.'
voiceSummary: TVS Srichakra Limited has filed a notice with the National Stock Exchange and BSE Limited regarding the release of a press release titled Eurogrip’s Diwali film visits Chilla, tracing why the festival comes a day late. The company submitted this intimation pursuant to SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The enclosed press release details the launch of a Diwali film named Worth the Wait by Eurogrip Tyres. The film explores a tradition in Chilla where Diwali is celebrated a day later. The content is also available on the company website at www.eurogriptyres.com. The filing was signed by Chinmoy Patnaik, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer. The document serves as an informational update to the stock exchanges and does not involve any corporate actions, resolutions, or financial transactions.
